Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
I've got a question. I think I know the answer, but want to make sure.

I'm playing a Malkavian deck with the Madness network in play. At the end
of another methusalah's minion phase, one of my untapped Malks calls a vote.
Can another untapped Malk play Rider Clause on the vote I'm calling? I
don't think there's any ruling against this type of thing, but wanted to
make sure.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. See the rules on playing reaction cards (specifically the part which
says that another Methuselah's minion must be the acting minion).
